newsitem.title: USA: Productivity Tech hopeful for 1997 sales.
newsitem.headline: Productivity Tech hopeful for 1997 sales.

text.p: Productivity Technologies Corp said its order backlog were at the highest level ever achieved by the company, increasing optimism about fiscal 1997 sales.
"Our backlogs are at the highest levels ever achieved by the company, which gives us confidence that we can reach record sales in fiscal 1997," Ray Friant, Productivity chairman, said.
He said the company was pleased with the pace of new orders from customers in the autmative, transportation and parts supply sectors.
